purpose: Phase 1B explicit dev FULL acquisition and structured quality; first live soft-delete is DRY_RUN only
expected_total_count: first successful page totalCount at execution time; never a hardcoded dataset size
completeness: page sequence complete; last page exact remainder; no empty page anomaly
all totalCount values equal first-page expected_total_count
all Raw response and metadata checksums verified before DB mutation
raw item count and observed unique count equal expected_total_count
normalization and persistence fatal errors zero
transaction_strategy: API acquisition, snapshot/ID/completeness validation and normalization outside transaction; DB-only atomic transaction with advisory lock, cooperative 60-second budget and per-query timeouts; all mutations roll back on transaction failure
future_reconciliation: separate user-approved task, fresh complete FULL and successful run; review candidates and observed source stability; never use SAMPLE/PARTIAL absence or an incomplete/failed FULL
